1.
Heard Mr. T Deuri, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. P.S. Lahkar, learned Addl.
PP, appearing for the State respondent.
2. The petitioner, namely, Kundan Basfore, has filed an application under section 438 Cr.P.C., for grant of pre arrest bail in connection with Tezpur PS Case No.1122/2022 under sections 420/376 IPC.
3. I have considered the submissions at the bar and have also Page No.# 2/2 perused the case diary.
4. It is submitted at the bar that the petitioner and the victim had a love affair and the victim was not induced in having physical relationship by the petitioner.
The relationship between the petitioner and the victim was consensual.

sentences.text: It is submitted at the bar that the case diary also reveals that the petitioner and the victim had a love affair and the petitioner did not commit sexual assault on the victim and so no case under section 376 IPC can be made out against the petitioner.
At best, a case under section 417 IPC which is bailable may exist against the petitioner.
6. I have considered the submissions at the bar with circumspection and has also perused the case diary.
The petitioner is a local resident and he has pledged to cooperate with the remaining part of the investigation.
The investigation has also progressed to a considerable extent.
7. In view of my foregoing discussions, petition is allowed.

The petitioner above named, shall be enlarged on bail of Rs.50,000/- with suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the condition that:
i.

The petitioner will appear before the IO within 10 days and cooperate with the investigation;
ii. the petitioner will not exercise threats to the witnesses;
8. Send back the case diary.
